# PATRICK RUBY

### Full Stack Engineer-Sao Paulo, Brazil

## EXPERIENCE

### Emerald Labs

Full Stack Engineer (2019-2024) Shipped the customer portal used by three thousand teams across the country. Cut page load time from four seconds to one by moving rendering to the edge. Designed the GraphQL gateway that unified six legacy REST services behind a single schema and typed client generation. Introduced visual regression testing that caught layout breaks before release.

### Cobalt Studio

Web Developer (2016-2019) Delivered twenty client sites on a fixed weekly release cadence. Built a shared component library that cut new project setup from days to hours for the whole team.

### Quartz Agency

Freelance Developer (2015-2016) Maintained WordPress and static sites for twelve small businesses. Handled everything from hosting to accessibility audits end to end.
